title: C++: Strategy Pattern
description: Implement the Strategy pattern to switch between sorting algorithms at runtime.

steps.title: Sorting Strategies
steps.description: Define a SortingStrategy interface with virtual void sort(vector<int>&) = 0. Implement BubbleSort and QuickSort strategies. Create a Sorter class that takes a strategy and uses it. Test both strategies.
hints: class Sorter { unique_ptr<SortingStrategy> strategy; void setStrategy(unique_ptr<SortingStrategy> s) { strategy = move(s); } void execute(vector<int>& v) { strategy->sort(v); } }

verification.failureMessage: Sort array using bubble sort strategy
